introduction: In Delhi, marriage registration is carried out under the Hindu Marriage Act or the Special Marriage Act through the Revenue Department's e-District portal. It provides conclusive proof of a legally recognized union.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Location: Delhi
  • Portal Used: e-District Delhi
  • Service Name: Registration of Marriage
  • Issuing Authority: Registrar of Marriage (under the Department of Revenue)
  • Processing Time: The portal indicates a processing time of 21 days.
  • Age Eligibility: Groom: at least 21 years old; Bride: at least 18 years old.
  • Application Method: Initial application, document upload, and slot booking are done online, followed by a mandatory physical visit to the Sub-Registrar/SDM office with original documents and witnesses.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Marriage Registration

Requirement: You must have soft copies (under 200KB for documents, 100KB for photos) for online upload, and you must carry the original hard copies plus photocopies during your offline visit.
For the Groom & Bride
  • Age Proof: 10th/SSC Marksheet, Birth Certificate, PAN Card, Passport, or Driving License.
  • Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License.
  • Address Proof (Before & After Marriage): Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Ration Card, Passport, Rent Agreement, or Utility Bills (Water/Electricity).
  • Affidavit: A mandatory notarized Affidavit printed on a ₹10 or ₹20 e-stamp paper for both the bride and groom separately. (These can be made at any CSC center, Notary shop, or typing shop for around ₹50-₹60).
  • Photograph: Passport-size color photographs.
For Marriage Proof
  • Certificate from a religious place (e.g., Temple/Gurudwara certificate) OR the Wedding Invitation Card.
  • One clear photograph of the marriage ceremony (e.g., tying the Mangalsutra or Varmala).
For Witnesses (Two Required)
  • Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, etc.
  • Address Proof: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport, etc.
  • Note: You will need to enter their father's/mother's names and contact details in the online form.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply for Marriage Certificate Online (Includes Offline Visit)

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Portal Registration: Visit the e-District Delhi website (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in). If you don't have an account, click on 'Register' (New User). Select your document type (Aadhaar or Voter ID), enter the number, fill out your basic personal details, and verify via OTP to generate your User ID and Password.
  2. Step 2: Login: Log in to the portal using your new User ID (Registration ID) and Password.
  3. Step 3: Select Service: From the dashboard menu, navigate to "Apply Online" > "Apply for Services." Scroll down to the Department of Revenue, find "Registration of Marriage," and click "Apply."
  4. Step 4: Solemnization Details: Enter exactly when and where the marriage took place. If it was at a religious place, check "Yes" and enter the name of the place and the person who officiated the wedding.
  5. Step 5: Fill Couple Details: Enter the Groom's and Bride's personal details (Name, DOB, Parents' names, marital status before marriage, religion, nationality, permanent address, present address, and contact details). Select the act for registration (e.g., Hindu Marriage Act).
  6. Step 6: Add Witnesses: Enter the personal details, addresses, and ID proof numbers of your two chosen witnesses.
  7. Step 7: Upload Documents: Upload the Age proof, ID proof, Address proof, and Affidavits for both the groom and bride. Upload the marriage ceremony photo, invitation card/religious place certificate, and witness ID/Address proofs in their respective fields.
  8. Step 8: Submit & Book Appointment: Once submitted, you will be prompted to book an appointment. Select your respective Sub-Registrar/SDM office, pick an available date (highlighted in green) from the calendar, and select a time slot.
  9. Step 9: Print Copies: Download and print the submitted Application Form and the Appointment Slip (Acknowledgment). Keep your original affidavits ready.
  10. Step 10: Offline Visit (Crucial Step): On your exact appointment date and time, the bride, groom, and both witnesses must physically visit the Sub-Registrar/SDM office. Carry the printed forms, appointment slip, and all original documents along with a set of self-attested photocopies. The officer will verify the originals, collect physical signatures, and may capture live photographs to approve the registration.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: How to Apply Offline

Important: The Delhi Government heavily mandates initiating the marriage registration online via the e-District portal. However, if you are completely unable to apply online, follow these offline options:
  • Option 1: SDM Visit / CSC Assistance: Visit the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / Marriage Registrar office (Revenue Department) of your local district. Alternatively, you can visit a nearby Common Service Center (CSC) where an operator will fill out the online form and book the slot for you for a nominal fee.
  • Option 2: Direct Manual Application: If applying entirely manually at the SDM office:
    • Collect the physical Marriage Registration Form from the office, fill it out, and attach self-attested photocopies of Age Proofs, ID Proofs, Address Proofs, Marriage Invitation, photos, and the original Notarized Affidavits.
    • Submit the file at the counter, pay the government registration fee (generally ₹100 if applying within 90 days of marriage; penalty fees apply for delays), and receive an appointment date.
    • You must then visit the office with your partner and witnesses on the assigned date with all original documents for the final physical verification and solemnization in front of the Marriage Officer.
afterApplying:
After Applying - Next Steps & Tracking

Application Processing

Once the physical verification is successful at the SDM office, the application moves to the final processing stage. The standard timeline for certificate generation is around 21 days from the date of your physical appointment.

Tracking & Download

You can track your application status on the e-District portal homepage using your Application Number. Once the certificate is approved and generated, you do not need to visit the office again. You can simply log in to your e-District account and download the digitally signed Marriage Certificate from the "Print/Download Certificate" section.
